## Summary

Implements **Stage A** of **P0.15c** (`docs/tickets/16_P0.15c__phase0-live-bindings-and-engine-e2e.md`) — the
offline, no-spend half: the **thin live shell behind every DI seam** (the "constructed at deploy" call-sites
that P0.15b's recorded deviation deliberately deferred), plus the run-task `agent-entry` and the real service
images. Every seam keeps its interface so the existing in-process fake suites stay green; the pure logic each
shell carries is unit-tested here (~55 new tests). The **wire behavior is Stage B** (operator-gated).

**Stage B was NOT run.** The ticket's modified autonomy contract requires explicit operator authorization + a
stated spend budget at each `[OPERATOR GATE]`, and the provider no-training verification (D-P0.13-2) for the
pilot. This session's prompt authorized neither, so the paid deploy + runs are surfaced as blocked, not run.
**GATE G1 stays blocked** while any G1-scoped `OPEN` DEFERRALS row remains.

## What changed

**New package `@rhema/live-clients`** — the deploy bindings for the orchestrator seams:
- `PgPoolTxRunner` (pg.Pool, RLS via `@rhema/db` `withTenant`), `RedisHeartbeatStore` (ioredis; index-set stale
  scan; KEEPTTL cancel), `RedisRunEventBus` (Redis pub/sub `RunEventPublisher`+`Subscriber`, refcounted),
  `PgBossQueue` (singletonKey + startAfter mapping), `GkeJobLauncher` + a **pure** two-uid Job/Secret manifest
  builder (sandbox node pool, digest-pinned image, 0400 harness-only run-token/credential Secret, SETUID/SETGID/
  SYS_ADMIN/SYS_CHROOT for the privilege drop + mount isolation), and a Secret-Manager RS256 key loader.

**App entrypoints (constructed at deploy):**
- `apps/api/src/server.ts` — constructs every seam + `createApp(deps)` + `@hono/node-server` with an SSE-safe idle
  timeout; adds the finalize→deliver bridge (`POST /internal/runs/:id/deliver`) with the `SqlObligationHook` and a
  per-run workspace-bound content store; consumes `circuitBreakerState().capMultiplier` when sizing a new run's cap.
- `apps/worker/src/main.ts` — live pg-boss registration: `run.start/resume/cancel` consumers, `run.reap` +
  `run.sweep_parked` + run-event maintenance crons; `reDebitOnResume` (per-episode key) + `handleParkedSweep`.
- `apps/egress-proxy/src/main.ts` — the running proxy: DB `RunContextResolver` (proxy-local, no orchestrator
  graph in the security-boundary image) + Sql writers/cap + the SIGHUP-refreshable Secret-Manager
  `anthropic-api-key` provider + undici forwarder; **`extractResponseServerToolsSse`** logs streaming
  server-tools (D-P0.07-5); a **real Dockerfile** replaces the P0.01 sleeper.

**Mirror / run-task:**
- `@rhema/mirror` `GcsContentStore` (workspace-bound `get` for tenant isolation; write-only `put` for the api).
- `apps/run-task/src/agent-entry.ts` — runs as uid `agent`, constructs `AgentSdkEngine` via `loadSdkQuery()`,
  drives one phase, streams mapped §12.5 events through the buffered `EventTransport`.
- `apps/run-task/src/materialize-work.ts` — the harness `/work` projection from the hydration manifest (fetches
  bytes via the ContentStore, chmods read paths 0444).
- Real `run-task` Dockerfile builds the pruned slice (`pnpm deploy`) + agent-entry + the vendored SDK.

**Orchestrator:** `randomUlids()` production id factory; `JobSpec` additively carries the per-run
runToken/proxyCredential so the live launcher delivers them to the harness (fakes ignore it).

## Design decisions

- **Isolated heavy deps.** The orchestration client libs (pg/ioredis/pg-boss/k8s/Secret-Manager) live in one new
  `@rhema/live-clients` package so `@rhema/orchestrator` stays pure. The egress-proxy uses a **proxy-local** DB
  resolver rather than importing the orchestrator graph into the security boundary.
- **Testable cores.** Each shell separates pure logic (manifest, encodings, RS256 load, SSE extraction, GCS key
  derivation, the phase driver) from the thin client call, so the parts that must be right now are unit-tested
  with fakes; the live pg/redis paths self-skip without env (mirroring `server-postgres.test.ts`).
- **Tenant isolation.** `GcsContentStore.get` is workspace-bound; an unbound (write-only) store rejects `get`
  loudly rather than risk a cross-tenant read.

live phase loop** (`runPhase`), which is the live execution — the agent-entry deliberately drives `startPhase`

`DEFERRALS.md` § P0.15c (D-P0.15c-3), not silently skipped.
